bead.title: Enforce embedded Kafka tenant ACLs
bead.description: PROBLEM: The embedded Kafka surface does not yet reject reads outside a queue's exact tenant/queue namespace. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:239-257` defines `authorize_fjord_topic_read`, but `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:277-332` and `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:1110-1203` construct and start the broker without wiring that authorization into any live read path. PROPOSED FIX: thread the deny-by-default ACL bridge into the broker's metadata/fetch handling so cross-tenant and cross-queue reads are rejected before any record is served. NON-SCOPE: implementing a second Kafka broker, reopening ADR-005 queue-data-plane consumer semantics, or restoring the superseded heimq target.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestKafkaTenantAclRejectsCrossTenantRead` proves a caller outside `(tenant_id, queue_id)` is denied access.
2. `TestKafkaTenantAclRejectsCrossQueueRead` proves a caller in the same tenant but different queue is denied access.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestKafkaTenantAclRejectsCrossTenantRead|TestKafkaTenantAclRejectsCrossQueueRead'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
